plain_language: The official pages describe possible sources, but this public, no-pay check obtained no actual historical S&P 500 20-day and 50-day breadth values or the data needed to reconstruct both. Therefore the planned return study cannot start from these source checks.
strategy_layer: LEI Module E index market breadth; input qualification only, no factor effect or trading conclusion

providers.evidence_basis: Prior ledger successfully read SPICE landing page; this run's official-domain search excerpts surfaced the landing, licensing and terms pages. Direct terms read failed.
confirmed_product_claims: SPICE is subscription-based and advertises historical S&P 500 constituents from 1964 and adds/drops from 1989
Its advertised advanced download covers constituent and corporate-action data
S&P offers constituent and corporate-action data in separately tailored subscription packages for research and analysis
not_confirmed_for_this_run: No dated B20 or B50 value or reconstructable member-and-price record was inspected
No stable security IDs, effective/announced/available times, full historical prices or corporate-action adjustment policy were inspected
No usable historical range, revision vintage, calendar, common B20/B50 denominator, missing-price policy or research/storage/export entitlement was established for this task
providers.rights: Public product descriptions do not grant use of subscription-only historical inputs. Exact entitlement and permitted local research/storage/export are unconfirmed; no subscription or contact action was taken.

providers.evidence_basis: Prior ledger successfully read ChartSchool definition; this run's official ChartSchool search result repeated it. Direct 20-day chart URL failed in the web reader.
confirmed_product_claims: ChartSchool defines breadth as stocks above a moving average divided by the index's stock count
It identifies S&P 500 percent above 50-day average as $SPXA50R
Its documented symbol set lists 50-, 150- and 200-day averages
not_confirmed_for_this_run: No official S&P 500 B20 symbol or 20-day series was confirmed; ChartSchool's 20-day smoothing example is not a B20 series
No dated B50 value or accessible historical series was inspected
Historical constituent membership, denominator eligibility, price adjustment, availability timing, revisions, range, and research/storage/export rights are unconfirmed
providers.rights: Viewing a public educational definition does not establish permission to obtain, store, export or reuse historical breadth values; task-specific research rights remain unconfirmed.

inference_boundary: This bounded public-source check did not qualify either route; it does not show the historical data do not exist or that the breadth factor fails. No return statistics were run.
